instagram.caption:
The lid you never lift.
The Bench and Transition Surface in the Mudroom. Somewhere to sit while you deal with your footwear, and a brief stop for things genuinely on their way out of the house.

What done looks like:
1. A bare seat wide enough for two people to lace boots at once
2. No more than three objects on the surface
3. One labelled basket at the end holding only what is leaving tomorrow

Free written steps for this zone, no signup: link in bio, or search 6S Success bench and transition surface.
